title: feat: add community image edits
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Routes community reference-image requests to the registrant’s OpenAI-compatible /images/edits endpoint as multipart form data.
- Probes image editing during the existing registration test and persists the result in one default-false column.
- Adds image input modality and /v1/images/edits metadata only after a valid edit response; generation-only models stay text-input.
- Keeps saved endpoint URLs and existing rows backward compatible, while reusing current image validation and billing.
- Validated with 99 focused tests, Enter and Gen typechecks, staging builds, and API docs validation.

Fixes #12645

gist.headline: Community models learned scissors
gist.blurb: Community image endpoints can now do more than make fresh pixels: they can edit the ones you bring along. If an endpoint passes the edit check, the hive quietly gives it the proper tools.
gist.summary: Community OpenAI-compatible endpoints can now support multipart requests at `/v1/images/edits`, with image-input capability and edit metadata automatically enabled only after a registration-time edit probe succeeds.
gist.impact: Developers can send reference images to validated community image-editing models through the standard edits API, while generation-only endpoints remain compatible and continue advertising text input only.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the community endpoint registry as a cozy garden workshop where image models are little retro picture frames. Polli tests one frame by carefully trimming and repainting a small landscape image with pixel-art scissors and a paintbrush, while a CRT robot holds an `/v1/images/edits` form; nearby generation-only frames simply grow fresh flowers, showing both capabilities can coexist.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden workshop where Polli, the cute bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a happy smile, and small rounded light-blue translucent wings, wears a tiny artist beret and carefully edits a pixel landscape in a glowing picture frame using little scissors and a paintbrush; a friendly chunky CRT monitor robot holds a form labeled `/v1/images/edits`, with code-plants and generation-only flower frames nearby. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, prominent soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, subtle scanlines, nostalgic but beautiful.
